title: Adaptive Config Advisor — staged cache & batching rollout with SLO circuit and drift detector
creator: Priya Rao
description:
Problem: Automated batching/caching recommendations yield significant cost savings but occasionally create transient latency or throughput regressions in tail percentiles. Current rollout flow applies config changes account-wide or via simple canary percentages and lacks a deterministic, reversible path tied to SLO envelopes and a drift detector.

Goal: Build an "Adaptive Config Advisor" flow that: (1) generates staged configuration changes for batching and prefix/KV cache parameters, (2) performs a shadow-apply and predictive scoring phase, (3) rolls changes out in controlled waves with an SLO-driven circuit (graduated throttle + automatic rollback), and (4) surfaces clear diagnostics and rollback rationale in the Console.

Scope: Engineering ticket to implement server-side orchestration, runtime hooks, and observability hooks for staged apply. This integrates with the existing advisor engine that suggests batch/window/cache profiles (separate PR). This ticket implements: staged execution, drift detector, SLO circuit logic, rollback policies, and dashboards/alerts for operators.

Non-goals: Rewriting advisor heuristics or model selection. Not implementing UI wizard (PM will follow with Console story).

Key concepts: shadow-apply (apply config to mirrored traffic for metrics collection without affecting production output), KV cache warmup window (prefix warm-up to ensure cache hit behavior is representative), token-percentile SLO envelope (p50/p95/p99 latency and throughput per-second per-model), graduated throttle steps (0%, 10%, 25%, 50%, 100%) with hold windows and early-exit on anomaly, and drift detector (statistical test to detect workload shift relative to baseline).

Runtime hooks required: dynamic config hot-reload, shadow routing path, metrics tagging for trial cohort, KV fill/freshness metric, per-cohort token emission counters, and a TTL-controlled rollback fence.
acceptance_criteria: Advisor can produce a staged config bundle (batch_size, micro_window_ms, kv_policy) and a deploy plan with graduated steps
System supports shadow-apply: mirrored requests run with candidate config and emit metrics tagged to trial_cohort without serving to end-user
SLO circuit enforces automatic halt and rollback if token-percentile latency or throughput falls outside configured envelope for hold window
Drift detector flags statistically significant distribution changes (arrival rate, sequence length, unique-prefix rate) and aborts rollout when detected
Operator dashboard shows per-step metrics (p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/s, kv_hit_rate, cost_estimate delta) and rollback reason
End-to-end integration test included that simulates a regressive workload and validates automatic rollback within the expected hold window
updates: 2026-02-08 - Spike completed: prototyped shadow-apply by duplicating request stream into a parallel runtime group. Found that KV warmup requires ~120s under median production arrival rates; recorded baseline metrics for /generate route (owner: Evan Chen).

2026-02-15 - Design review with PM & Design. Maya Sanchez requested clearer rollback reasoning strings for Console; Riley Morgan suggested timeline visualization for step transitions. Action: add 'reason_code' + human-readable message to rollback event (owner: Evan Chen).

2026-02-22 - Implemented initial SLO envelope evaluator. Chose token-percentile-based SLOs rather than request-count windows to better capture per-token cost/liability. Added conservative default envelopes to avoid false positives. (owner: Priya Rao)

2026-03-02 - Integration test added: synthetic traffic generator now supports bursty arrival patterns and prefix distribution knobs. Verified rollback triggers on 99th percentile latency increase > 30% within 60s. Adjusted hold window behavior to 90s to reduce oscillation. (owner: QA Team)

2026-03-09 - Security review prep: documented threat model for shadow paths (no user output exposure, metrics-only), KMS usage for config bundles, and access controls for rollout approvals. Security asked for audit log hooks (added).

2026-03-12 - Demo run against staging: applied candidate config for a top-tier customer workload in shadow mode; KV hit-rate increased by 12% and token cost estimate decreased by 7% with no SLO violations. Ready for limited live pilot behind feature-flag. (owner: Evan Chen)
notes: Trade-offs: aggressive rollout speeds save cost but risk customer-facing latency spikes; default policy will bias to slower ramps with per-tenant opt-in for faster ramps.

Testing plan: unit tests for SLO envelope logic, e2e simulation with synthetic traffic, staging pilot with feature-flag and manual guardrails, then automated pilot with emergency rollback throttle if more than one customer sees degradations.
Observability: add cookbooks for interpreting kv_hit_rate, cache_fill_rate, per-cohort p99 token latency, and cost delta projections to reduce on-call churn.

Follow-ups: PM story to add Console UX for configuring per-tenant risk tolerances and 'opt-in fast lanes' for high-tier customers. Design to provide timeline visualization and rollback messaging templates.
